facts.label: In English
facts.value: Qing River head-water from 青龙桥 round the north of the gardens

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a river outside the garden walls

facts.label: Where
facts.value: osm way 653499487 (清河, canal): starts at 青龙桥 (116.2648, 40.0038) and runs NE then E north of the walls; today's channel, regulated; B for the line near the bridge, C elsewhere

facts.label: Note
facts.value: [j99:27b-28a] 其水由青龍橋來東北流繞圓明園後約三里許至卓房村, then about 3 li to the 清河; [j100:6a] 其旁流之北歸青龍橋者則經圎明園後合御園諸水東北注清河. Qing name 会清河 (S1225). The 圆明园 and 长春园 outflow (七空闸) joins it [j80:7b]. Also: LoC Beijing cheng jiao tu c.1886 read, fit rms 226 m (Qing He), 2295 m from the point used.
